en: For the Chief Musician. By David.

ja: 指揮者のために。ダビデの詩。

p.src: 1  In the LORD, I take refuge. How can you say to my soul, “Flee as a bird to your mountain”?

ja: け所を求める。 どうしてあなたがたは
en: In the LORD, I take refuge. How can you say to my soul, “Flee as a bird to your mountain”?
u.src: 1  In the LORD, I take refuge. How can you say to my soul, “Flee as a bird to your mountain”?

p.src: 2  For, behold, the wicked bend their bows. They set their arrows on the strings, that they may shoot in darkness at the upright in heart.

ja: をつがえ、 暗闇の中から
en: For, behold, the wicked bend their bows. They set their arrows on the strings, that they may shoot in darkness at the upright in heart.
u.src: 2  For, behold, the wicked bend their bows. They set their arrows on the strings, that they may shoot in darkness at the upright in heart.

p.src: 3  If the foundations are destroyed, what can the righteous do?

ja: されたなら、 義人に
en: If the foundations are destroyed, what can the righteous do?
u.src: 3  If the foundations are destroyed, what can the righteous do?

p.src: 4  The LORD is in his holy temple. The LORD is on his throne in heaven. His eyes observe. His eyes examine the children of men.

ja: の王座に着いておられる。 その
は見渡し、 そのまなざしは
en: The LORD is in his holy temple. The LORD is on his throne in heaven. His eyes observe. His eyes examine the children of men.
u.src: 4  The LORD is in his holy temple. The LORD is on his throne in heaven. His eyes observe. His eyes examine the children of men.

p.src: 5  The LORD examines the righteous, but his soul hates the wicked and him who loves violence.

ja: は義人を調べられるが、
en: The LORD examines the righteous, but his soul hates the wicked and him who loves violence.
u.src: 5  The LORD examines the righteous, but his soul hates the wicked and him who loves violence.

p.src: 6  On the wicked he will rain blazing coals; fire, sulfur, and scorching wind shall be the portion of their cup.

en: On the wicked he will rain blazing coals; fire, sulfur, and scorching wind shall be the portion of their cup.
u.src: 6  On the wicked he will rain blazing coals; fire, sulfur, and scorching wind shall be the portion of their cup.

p.src: 7  For the LORD is righteous. He loves righteousness. The upright shall see his face.

ja: される。 心のまっすぐな
en: For the LORD is righteous. He loves righteousness. The upright shall see his face.
u.src: 7  For the LORD is righteous. He loves righteousness. The upright shall see his face.
